svg.title: Mickey Hub hardware functional overview
svg.desc: The Linux host connects to USB audio, CSI camera, I2C depth, UART displays, fan and expansion. RP2350 coordinates power and communicates with the host by UART and ESP32S3 by I2C. Three assembled Rd-03E radars and motion sensors connect to ESP32S3. A UPS and 3S battery supply the system. This is a functional design overview, not a pin-level wiring guide.

g.text: A functional map of the complete hardware platform
Carrier PCB · XIAO adapters · interface modules
CSI image stream to the Linux host
UART paths through TX gate modules
M16 main hold · M1 host · M2 radar
M15 relay interface · M17 retained / unused
Rated power executor still to be finalized
M20 / M21 serial interfaces and M42 fan interface are shown on their functional paths; M22 is retained but unused.
Radar protocol migration, ToF/fan qualification and power completion remain open.
Functional overview · current assembly · no servo motors populated
